recentItems.title: BRICS Across Continents | Brazilian Barbecue Meets Dongguan Roast Goose
recentItems.description:
In Dongguan, the Consul General of Brazil in Guangzhou tries a local favorite: roast goose. Instantly impressed, he is eager to return the culinary favor with a specialty from his own culture. As the flavors of southern China meet Brazilian barbecue, they remind us that good food tastes even better when shared.

recentItems.title: UN coordinator highlights importance of individual climate action
recentItems.description:
UN Resident Coordinator in China Stephen Jackson spoke about the story of American teacher Ronald Sakolsky and Chinese environmentalist Yin Yuzhen, whose connection began with a shared commitment to combating desertification. Highlighting their inspirational story, he emphasized that combating climate change requires not only governmental and multilateral action, but also individual contributions.#📺GoodPoint

recentItems.title: Thomas Bergersen talks about his musical journey in China
recentItems.description:
From Hollywood blockbusters to viral videos, Thomas Bergersen's music has reached millions around the world. This August, the Norwegian composer and co-founder of Two Steps From Hell embarked on his first tour of China. Shen Li sat down with Bergersen to uncover the stories behind his music – and his long-awaited encounter with Chinese audiences.#ThomasBergersen#TwoStepsFromHell

recentItems.title: Rediscovering London's first Chinatown
recentItems.description:
London's Chinatown is one of the capital's best-known neighborhoods.

But before Soho in the West End, Limehouse, in the old East End docks, was home to London's first Chinatown.

CGTN's Jen Copestake visits a new exhibition in London's first Chinatown, bringing the story back to life.

recentItems.title: Another podium finish for Z-X-MOTO's Valentin Debise in France
recentItems.description:
Chinese motorbike manufacturer Z-X-MOTO has secured another podium finish at the French round of the Superbike World Championship.

French rider Valentin Debise finished third in his home race, adding to his wins in Portugal, Hungary, the Czech Republic and Italy.

CGTN's Sarah Coates tells us more.
